mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite (account_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM favorite WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
SELECT * FROM favorite WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT f.id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.create_time, COALESCE(w.title, r.title) AS target_title FROM favorite f LEFT JOIN work w ON f.target_type = 'WORK' AND f.target_id = w.id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON f.target_type = 'REQUIREMENT' AND f.target_id = r.id WHERE f.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
